description: Source code implementing a class and function to wrap switch statements in blocks for AST compatibility with HLSL output, part of the ANGLE project.

classes.name: WrapSwitchStatementsInBlocksTraverser
classes.description: Traverses AST to wrap switch statements in blocks and declare switch-scoped variables outside the switch.

methods.name: visitSwitch
methods.description: Visits switch nodes in AST, wraps them in blocks if they contain declarations.

methods.name: WrapSwitchStatementsInBlocks
methods.description: Main function to initiate traversal and wrapping of switch statements in the AST.
